dict.string: Transcription Studio captures system audio to transcribe meetings and calls. Transcription runs entirely on this Mac; the recording and its transcript are stored in your private FCT account so they reach your other devices.
Transcription Studio adds meetings you review from a transcript to your calendar. It only ever adds — it never reads your existing calendar.

Transcription Studio matches names in your transcripts to your contacts so speakers and mentions show real names. It only reads your contacts; the name you bind to a speaker is saved with that transcript in your FCT account.
Transcription Studio uses Face ID to unlock sessions you've marked private, so only you can open them.

Transcription Studio can tag a recording with the place you made it, so you can find it by location later. It's captured only while recording, and the tag is saved with that session in your private FCT account so it reaches your other devices.

Transcription Studio records from your microphone. Speech recognition and speaker identification run entirely on this device; the recording and its transcript are stored in your private FCT account so they reach your other devices.
Transcription Studio adds action items you review from a transcript to your reminders.
